rubrics.justification: No image was provided and the model appropriately avoided fabricating morphology; however, it could not perform any actual blastocyst feature assessment.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, endometrium, male factor, BMI, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and embryo-related expectations.
Reasoning is logical and consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy as the dominant factor; minor overreach exists around some adjunctive considerations and lifestyle impact magnitude.

Generally aligned with IVF practice regarding SET, counseling, luteal support, and consideration of PGT-A in advanced maternal age; slight deviation from strict evidence-based guidance in mentioning intralipids/steroids/acupuncture without clear indication.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer counseling, lifestyle modification, luteal support, and future planning including PGT-A and donor oocyte discussion, though some suggestions remain somewhat general.
